subject: Procurement steps for term extension & capacity uplift
messages:
From: Olivia Chen <olivia.chen@orthosys.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>
Cc: ProcureOps Team <procure@orthosys.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Feb 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Procurement steps for upcoming term extension and capacity bump

Hi Naomi,

Thanks for the conversation last week. We are preparing the internal procurement packet for the upcoming term extension and want to include a capacity uplift (add ~4 dedicated GPUs to our dedicated pool). To move this through our procurement portal I need:

- An updated SOW with the new capacity + revised term (we aim to extend 12 months).
- Any standard redlines you expect for audit/hosting and data residency.
- Confirmation of pricing for committed vs burst throughput and any potential one-time migration/setup fees.
- SOC 2 evidence or pointer to the security questionnaire for our InfoSec review.
- Instructions on re-onboarding Redwood in our vendor portal (we had previously been onboarded but our portal requires a refresh for materially changed terms).

Target timeline: ProcureOps would like to start approvals this week to complete before 28 Feb. Can you confirm what we can provide to them and whether Redwood can accept our standard PO terms?

Attachments: none from our side yet — happy to share the PO template if useful.

Thanks,
Olivia Chen
Procurement Lead, OrthoSys
olivia.chen@orthosys.com
+1 (415) 555-0182
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>
To: Olivia Chen <olivia.chen@orthosys.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Feb 2026 11:03:22 -0800
Subject: Re: Procurement steps for upcoming term extension and capacity bump

Hi Olivia — thanks for the clear list. High-level next steps from our side:

1) I will attach a draft SOW (capacity bump + 12-month term) and a short pricing appendix.
2) For InfoSec: we can provide our SOC 2 Type II report and a completed security questionnaire; I will include the link to the current documentation.
3) Procurement portal: Redwood requires a quick re-onboarding (standard form) when contractual terms change materially. We can send the portal packet and support a ProcureOps rep through the upload.
4) PO terms: we accept standard POs but any non-standard payment terms or indemnity changes will need commercial/legal review (we can flag those).

I'll loop in Marissa (sales ops) and Sean (legal/sales lead) to confirm pricing and to prepare the redline SOW. Can you share your PO template and the timeline for approvals?

Attaching: SOW_Redwood_Capacity_Bump_template.docx (draft)
Link to SOC 2 & questionnaire: https://redwood.docs/security/SOC2

Best,
Naomi Feldman
Senior Sales Manager, Redwood Inference
naomi@redwood.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Feb 2026 08:47:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Procurement steps for upcoming term extension and capacity bump

Naomi / Sean — forwarding Olivia's ask. Quick notes from pricing ops:

- Pricing: committed capacity for +4 GPUs (p4 class) gives 18% unit discount vs on-demand; include a 30-day burst window at 1.5x base rate. Will attach a breakdown.
- One-time setup: $6,000 for dedicated pool reallocation and KV cache warm-up/initial migration assistance.
- If they sign a 12-month extension (deal_id RDW-EXP-2026-089) we can approve an additional 5% volume discount, but I need sales leadership sign-off.

Action items for Naomi: confirm final list price you'd like to present.
Action items for Sean: confirm if legal is OK with the PO terms and the audit clause we add to SOW.

Attaching: pricing-breakdown-ortho-2026.xlsx

—Marissa
From: Sean Gallagher <sean@redwood.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Feb 2026 10:20:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Procurement steps for upcoming term extension and capacity bump

Quick read: legal is comfortable with the standard 12-month term extension. A couple of notes:

- Please include the audit/access clause in SOW section 4.2 (we will provide a limited-scope audit window and MFA-based access for logs).
- We will accept the standard PO but any addendum that changes indemnity or liability caps requires escalation.
- I attached a redline of the SOW with the audit language included; Marissa, you can update pricing appendix to reflect the 5% conditional discount once sales leadership confirms.

Attaching: SOW_v2_redline.pdf

Sean
VP, Commercial Operations
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>

Date: Tue, 17 Feb 2026 14:43:00 -0800
Subject: Final SOW & DocuSign for OrthoSys term extension and capacity uplift

Hi Olivia — following up with the agreed artifacts so you can complete your procurement packet. Summary:

- Final SOW attached: SOW_OrthoSys_Final.pdf (capacity +4 GPUs, 12-month term, audit clause in 4.2).
- Pricing: committed discount applied; one-time setup fee included. Detailed breakdown is in the attached appendix.
- Security: SOC 2 Type II & questionnaire link provided earlier; logs access and MFA details are in section 4.2.
- Procurement portal: Redwood will accept your PO. We also prepared a DocuSign envelope to streamline signatures: https://app.docusign.com/prepare?envelopeId=XYZ-123-ORT

Next steps for ProcureOps:
1) Upload SOW_OrthoSys_Final.pdf and PO to your portal (we will accept the standard PO).
2) Complete DocuSign (link above) or return a countersigned PDF.
3) Once signed and PO is received, we will schedule the onboarding window for the capacity change (target cutover: 2026-03-10).

If you'd like a short 30-min sync to walk ProcureOps through the upload, Marissa and I can join tomorrow morning PST.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this across the finish line.

Best regards,
